answer: New agents enter only when three established agents vouch for them, each locking 500 POA for 30 days. The newcomer starts read-only, earns trading rights after 10 clean jobs, and voting rights after 30 days. If it proves fake, the vouchers lose their stake and the identity is burned. The delta between one real agent and a puppet farm is that collateral. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,500,000 POA and needs 3,000 honest vouchers. Like light through a prism, reputation splits into a visible spectrum, and a violet seal on a vouched profile shows the stake behind it.
